name: Woven by Adam Smith
address: Coworth Park, Blacknest Road, Ascot, SL5 7SE

menus.name: dinner menu
menus.note: Wednesday to Saturday; cheese £16 supplement or £28 as an extra course; a plant-based menu is available; wine pairing price from its OpenTable page, October 2026

menus.name: lunch menu
menus.note: Friday to Sunday; scallop course £25 supplement; wine pairing price from its OpenTable page, October 2026

hotel: Coworth Park, a Dorchester Collection hotel
bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms or OpenTable, or by phone.
cancellation: A £80 deposit per person secures the table. Cancel at least 48 hours ahead; after that the deposit isn't refunded. Tables are held for 20 minutes for late arrivals.
groups: The Conservatory private dining room seats up to 12.
children: Children aged 8 and over at dinner; all ages at lunch, with a children's menu at £65.
duration: About 2½ hours for up to four people, 3 hours for larger tables.
